  PROBLEM: retry_report_timeout() reports status=retry_queued_timeout and prints "stayed queued for Ns" whenever RETRY_RUN_ID is set and RETRY_RUN_STARTED_EPOCH is empty, without checking that any poll actually observed the run as queued. Three paths reach it without a parsed status: a rate-limit stall (lines 530-535, 625-626), a failed run GET (lines 620-633, continue at 631), and a malformed payload (lines 634-640, continue at 638). The loop-end timeout (lines 514/692) also reaches it.
  WHY: An API, rate-limit or read failure is misattributed to runner saturation with an invented duration (changelog.d/stuck-states-p4-phase4b-timing.md tells operators this status means the runner pool was saturated), and test_phase4b_reset_beyond_deadline_fails_closed locks this in by asserting status=retry_queued_timeout with "run" not in requests (tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_review_blocked_budget.py:458-465/458-471). Reviewers disagree on severity: MAJOR from anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and openai_gpt-6-luna; none stated by google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite; NIT from z-ai_glm-5_3-flash (step exits 1 either way, so diagnostic-only). The highest is used. Suggested fix: require the last parsed RETRY_STATUS to be queued|waiting|pending|requested, otherwise fall through to retry_timeout or a distinct retry_read_failed, and update the test to expect retry_timeout.
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_verify_bait_removed.sh:485-499 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The two branches of retry_report_timeout() order their output differently. The latched branch prints `::error::`, then the detail line, then `status=retry_timeout` (lines 493, 496, 498). The queued branch prints `::error::`, then `status=retry_queued_timeout` (lines 489, 490).
  WHY: There is no runtime break, but the log surface is inconsistent for triage tooling that expects `status=` immediately after `::error::`.

It is reached from line 535 (PR read rate-limited), line 626 (run GET rate-limited) and line 692 (loop end), including when the run GET fails (line 631 continue) or the payload is malformed (line 638 continue). test_phase4b_reset_beyond_deadline_fails_closed asserts status=retry_queued_timeout with "run" not in requests.
